analysis.title: GS US TMT quick hits
key_insights: NDX fell about 275 bps intraday to its 200-dma, driven by semis. SOX fell about 540 bps intraday and set a new low close for 2H, below the late-July lows.

NDX is down about 611 bps over the last 3 sessions, the biggest 3-day slide since Liberation Day (about 20 months ago). The equal-weight S&P (RSP) is up about 1% over the same 3 days, and the R2K now outperforms the NDX year to date.

Desk flows show little defense across Semis/AI. Risk appetite is weaker amid a 'wait and see' mode, and the market is more discerning about the linearity of the AI build-out beyond CY27, which is pressuring multiples.
Lower oil and yields (about 2-month lows) lifted only consumer pockets of tech (OTAs, Internet, Payments). AI/Tech closed on the lows of the day.
Top client questions: INTC and AMD drag, why semis are heavy, AMZN bounce, MRVL and LITE action, strength in analog semis, and why DDOG, RBRK, MDB and FTNT fell so much.

GS Econ/GIR election preview expects the data center focus to fade after the election. A national moratorium looks unlikely, Congress might limit data center tax incentives, and focus likely shifts to AI regulation, where restrictive regulation looks unlikely.

The GS Analyst Index (GSAI) fell 6.5pt to 49.1 in October, below 50 for the first time since April 2025. The ISM manufacturing index rose in October above expectations, with new orders and production up, employment down, and prices paid easing slightly.

AAPL F4Q: revenue $114.5bn (+12% y/y) vs consensus $113.47bn, iPhone revenue $57.583bn vs consensus $56.49bn, gross margin 47.9% vs consensus 47.6%, EPS $2.10 vs consensus about $2.00. Shares +30 bps after hours (was -2%).
Fabrinet (FN) +13% after hours on a beat and a guide above consensus: 2Q revenue guide $1.6-1.65B vs consensus $1.48B, EPS guide $4.77-4.92 vs consensus $4.43.
PLTR +1% after hours on a beat and raise: US Commercial revenue +148% y/y, FY US commercial revenue guide raised to >143% y/y from >134%, FCF guide raised to $4.8-5bn from $4.5-4.7bn.
ON -2% after hours: F4Q revenue guide $1.715-1.815bn vs consensus $1.74bn and EPS guide 95c-$1.07 vs consensus 96c. ON announced the Ferric acquisition for about $600mn.
SBAC: GIR expects mixed trading on a site leasing revenue and tower cash flow miss. EBITDA was in line and 2026E guidance was lowered on tower cash flow and EBITDA due to forex and asset sales.
Week ahead earnings most asked about: AAPL, PLTR, AMD, ANET, BKNG, DDOG, UBER, APP, EXPE, Unity, FWONK, MCHP, LYV, NET, ABNB. US midterm elections and JOLTS are tomorrow.
The S&P 500 low vol index has been negatively correlated to the Nasdaq since the summer.

earnings_insights: AAPL F4Q (reported 11/2 after close): total revenue $114.5bn (+12% y/y) reported vs consensus $113.47bn (+10.7% y/y). Services revenue $31.573bn vs consensus $31.577bn. iPhone revenue $57.583bn vs consensus $56.49bn. Gross margin 47.9% (includes about 1pt tariff refund tailwind) vs consensus 47.6%. EPS $2.10 reported (includes 5c tariff tailwind) vs consensus about $2.00. Call focus: C4Q gross margin outlook and C4Q revenue guide vs consensus +6% y/y.
FN (reported 11/2 after close): 2Q revenue guide $1.6-1.65B vs consensus $1.48B. 2Q EPS guide $4.77-4.92 vs consensus $4.43.

PLTR 3Q (reported 11/2 after close): US total revenue +119% y/y (vs +115% last quarter). US Commercial revenue +148% y/y (vs +149%). US Commercial RDV $6.517bn (+4% q/q). Rule of 40 at 158% (vs 155%). FY US commercial revenue guide raised to >143% y/y (prior >134%). FCF guide $4.8-5bn (prior $4.5-4.7bn).

ON F3Q (reported 11/2 after close): revenue $1.722bn (+7.4% q/q) vs guide midpoint $1.70bn. Gross margin 41.2% vs guide 40-42%. EPS 90c vs guide 81-93c. F4Q guide: revenue $1.715-1.815bn vs consensus $1.74bn, gross margin 41.5-43.5%, EPS 95c-$1.07 vs consensus 96c. 3Q AI data center revenue grew 39% q/q and 175% y/y.

SBAC (reported 11/2 after close): site leasing revenue and tower cash flow missed. EBITDA was largely in line with consensus. 2026E guidance was lowered on tower cash flow and EBITDA due to forex and the Chile and Ecuador asset sales. AFFO was raised slightly on lower maintenance capex.

Earnings tonight (11/2 after close): AAPL, AEIS, FN, MTCH, ON, PLTR, ROKU, SBAC, UPWK, VOYG, WAY. Pre-market 11/3: CLVT, DOCN, DT, ETN, FISV, IPGP, LBTYA, SHOP, TeamViewer, UPST, VRNS, XMTR, Zalando, ZBRA. Post-market 11/3: ALAB, AMD, ANET, ANGI, BKNG, CPNG, DUOL, FLYW, FRSH, HURN, NVTS, OUST, PCOR, RVLV, SWKS, TOST, TREE, TRVG, XYZ.
